conceptual assets.concept: Instruction memory contents (words stored in IMEM and returned on bus reads)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The fetch flow produces read data from stored IMEM contents and returns it on the bus: ROM path reads into rdata (`rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr));`) and RAM path assembles rdata from per-byte RAM arrays after writes (`mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)` etc and `rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr))` ...). The bus response is driven from rdata (`bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0')`). Therefore the values held in mem_rom_c, mem_ram_b0..3 and rdata are the instruction words returned; unauthorized modification of these stored values would violate instruction-fetch correctness (Integrity).

conceptual assets.concept: Requested instruction address used to index IMEM
conceptual assets.reasoning: The concurrent assignment `addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2));` computes the memory index used by reads and writes (`to_integer(addr)` is used to index mem_rom_c(...) and mem_ram_b#(...) in the mem_access processes). The value of addr therefore determines which instruction word is accessed; corruption of addr would change the accessed location and violate correct fetch/write behavior (Integrity).

conceptual assets.concept: Read-response enable (rden) that gates delivery of read data
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus_feedback process registers the read condition (`rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw);` on rising_edge(clk_i)) and the module only drives read data when rden = '1' (`bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0')`). rden therefore controls whether a requested read's data is presented; preventing rden from asserting would block delivery of read data (Availability).
